Flow.description: Authenticated Experience Cloud New Hire/Rehire intake. Form values stay in the active interview only. Creates a generic Case shell, a Box folder, and a transient Doc Gen submission. Does not persist request-subject PII on Case.
Flow.label: HR New Hire Intake

fields.name: faultCaseCreateText
fields.fieldText: The request could not be created. No Case was saved. Re-enter the form to try again.

fields.name: faultFolderText
fields.fieldText:
The Case was created but the Box folder could not be provisioned. Status is Folder Failed. Do not resubmit this Case; start a new request after an operator reviews the folder association.

Case Number: {!Create_HR_Case.CaseNumber}

fields.name: formIntro
fields.fieldText: Complete this New Hire / Rehire request. Values are sent to Box and are not stored as Case field data.

fields.name: inStartDate
fields.helpText: Notify HR if this date changes.

fields.name: inPriorCertificationDetails
fields.helpText: Optional. Supporting backup can be uploaded to Box after submit.

fields.name: inRateReason
fields.helpText: Required when compensation is Above minimum or Above maximum. Above-maximum approval documents can be uploaded to Box after submit.

validationRule.errorMessage: A rate reason is required when compensation is Above minimum or Above maximum.

fields.name: inAttestation
fields.fieldText: I attest that this request is accurate and authorized

fields.name: receiptStatus
fields.fieldText:
Your HR request was accepted for processing.

Case Number: {!vCaseNumber}
